title: Morocco – Blue Cities & Golden Dunes

heroImage.alt: Traditional Moroccan architecture and decorative tilework

introduction: A twelve-day journey from Casablanca to Marrakech through Morocco's Atlantic coast, blue mountain towns, imperial cities, Roman ruins, desert landscapes and High Atlas scenery.
The route includes Chefchaouen, Fes, the Erg Chebbi dunes, Todra Gorge, the Dades Valley, Aït Ben Haddou and Marrakech.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Casablanca
itinerary.description: Arrive at Mohammed V International Airport, coordinate with the group, visit Hassan II Mosque and walk along the Atlantic Corniche.
itinerary.accommodation: Traditional riad in the heart of the city

itinerary.title: Casablanca - Rabat - Chefchaouen
itinerary.description: Visit Rabat's Hassan Tower and Kasbah of the Udayas, then drive through the Rif Mountains to Chefchaouen.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel in the heart of the blue city

itinerary.title: Chefchaouen
itinerary.description: Take a guided walk through Chefchaouen's blue medina, then use the afternoon for independent exploration, Ras El-Ma or an optional hike toward the Spanish Mosque.
itinerary.accommodation: Hotel in the heart of the blue city

itinerary.title: Chefchaouen - Fes
itinerary.description: Travel south via the Roman ruins of Volubilis and imperial Meknes before arriving in Fes.

itinerary.title: Fes
itinerary.description: Explore Fes el Bali with a guide, including the Chouara Tanneries, artisan souks and the area around Al Quaraouiyine, then enjoy free time.

itinerary.title: Fes - Merzouga
itinerary.description: Drive south through the Middle Atlas, stop near Azrou's cedar forest and continue toward Merzouga and the Erg Chebbi dunes for a sunset camel ride.

itinerary.title: Merzouga
itinerary.description: Visit Khamlia for a Gnawa music experience, then return to the dunes for free time and another night in the Sahara.

itinerary.title: Merzouga - Boumalne Dades
itinerary.description: Leave the Sahara and visit Todra Gorge before continuing through the Dades Valley and its unusual sandstone formations.

itinerary.title: Dades Valley - Aït Ben Haddou
itinerary.description: Travel west through kasbah country, visit Skoura, the Tawabil cooperative and Atlas Film Studios, then stay at Aït Ben Haddou.

itinerary.title: Aït Ben Haddou - Marrakech
itinerary.description: See Aït Ben Haddou around sunrise, then cross the High Atlas Mountains via Tizi n'Tichka before descending into Marrakech.

itinerary.title: Marrakech
itinerary.description: Visit Jardin Majorelle and Le Jardin Secret, have lunch at the Amal Women's Training Center, then spend the afternoon exploring independently.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Free time in Marrakech before transfers to Marrakech Menara Airport according to individual flight times.
